name: The Bungalow Restaurant
address: 5 Meeding St, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Cosy Plett hideaway serving hearty comfort food in a relaxed garden setting on Meeding Street.
description_long:
Tucked away on a quiet Plettenberg Bay street, The Bungalow offers a laid-back escape from the hustle of the beachfront. The garden setting creates an intimate atmosphere where locals and visitors settle in for generous plates of comfort food without the formality of fancier venues.

The menu leans into crowd-pleasers with honest execution—think satisfying mains that won't break the bank and a welcoming vibe that makes solo diners and groups feel equally at home. It's the kind of spot where you can linger over a meal without feeling rushed, perfect for a casual lunch or easy-going dinner when you want good food without the fuss.
